entries.0173500e9cfaa92f: A medtech company that sells medical devices used for diagnosis and treatment around the world, centered on endoscopes.
entries.06412b2f4233d183: A business that handles products used for treatment and procedures in urology, respiratory medicine, surgery, otorhinolaryngology and gynecology. Manufacturing and sales are carried out by the company itself, by domestic subsidiaries such as Olympus Medical Systems Corp., Olympus Marketing Co., Ltd., Shirakawa Olympus Co., Ltd., Aomori Olympus Co., Ltd. and T-Medics Co., Ltd., and by overseas subsidiaries such as Olympus America Inc., Olympus Europa SE & Co. KG, Olympus Deutschland GmbH, Gyrus ACMI, Inc., Olympus Winter & Ibe GmbH, Olympus (Beijing) Sales & Service Co.,Ltd., Olympus Korea Co., Ltd. and Olympus Singapore Pte. Ltd. Sony Olympus Medical Solutions Inc., an affiliate, is also listed among the main companies. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥313,109 million (¥322,759 million in the previous year, down 3.0%), the smaller of the two reportable segments, and revenue declined. Excluding the effect of exchange rates, revenue fell 4.3% year on year, according to the company.
entries.4193550c90a45ee7: A business segment not included in the reportable segments, covering research and development and exploratory activities related to new businesses. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥208 million (¥530 million in the previous year), a small amount compared with consolidated revenue of ¥1,010,676 million. Because it is not a reportable segment, it is placed last regardless of revenue size.
entries.42567d5597cd70da: A field of services that goes beyond product sales. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue rose year on year, led by strong performance in Europe.
entries.6e0d868804fde7b8: A field covering gastrointestinal endoscope units and equipment for observation and ultrasound diagnosis. Revenue increased year on year in the fiscal year ended March 2026. Although sales were sluggish at the start of the year, the company states that double-digit growth was achieved in North America, Europe and Asia-Oceania in the fourth quarter. In China, intensifying competition and preferential policies for domestic products are challenges, while in Japan, tight hospital budget execution continues. In Japan, the 'EVIS X1' video system center, equipped with an observation mode combining NBI and TXI technologies, was launched in the third quarter of the consolidated accounting period.
entries.6f04098daa46015b: Treatment areas that do not fall within the three fields above. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue declined, mainly in surgical devices, which were affected by shipment suspensions.
entries.7fd22ec8a071b91b: A business that handles gastrointestinal endoscopes, treatment tools used for their diagnosis and treatment, and medical services. Manufacturing and sales are carried out by the company itself, by domestic subsidiaries such as Olympus Medical Systems Corp., Olympus Marketing Co., Ltd., Aizu Olympus Co., Ltd., Shirakawa Olympus Co., Ltd., Nagano Olympus Co., Ltd., Aomori Olympus Co., Ltd. and T-Medics Co., Ltd., and by overseas subsidiaries such as Olympus America Inc., Olympus Europa SE & Co. KG, Olympus Deutschland GmbH, Olympus (Beijing) Sales & Service Co.,Ltd. and Olympus (Suzhou) Medical Device Co., Ltd. Swan EndoSurgical, Inc., a jointly controlled entity, is also listed among the main companies. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥697,359 million (¥674,043 million in the previous year, up 3.5%), the larger of the two reportable segments. This category became a reportable segment replacing the previous 'Endoscopy Business' and 'Therapeutic Equipment Business' from the interim consolidated accounting period, in line with the reorganization of business divisions effective April 1, 2025. Excluding the effect of exchange rates, revenue rose 2.1% year on year, according to the company.
entries.8a2e81eb41154b3f: A field covering diagnostic and therapeutic tools used together with endoscopes. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue rose year on year, supported by regional execution and the effect of new products, despite headwinds from shipment suspensions of some products. In addition to stent-related products, ERCP (endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography) related products used for endoscopic diagnosis and treatment of the pancreatic and bile ducts also contributed to growth.
entries.a3f9b91ad3ac380f: A field of products used in urology treatment. Revenue increased year on year in the fiscal year ended March 2026. In the previous year, there was an upward effect from the clearing of backorders. In the current year, sales declined in North America, which was affected by shipment suspensions of some products, but revenue increased in Europe, where several countries, including the United Kingdom, performed well. Products for resection related to BPH (benign prostatic hyperplasia) performed steadily.
entries.b29456409a9fdb8b: A field of products used for diagnosis and procedures in respiratory medicine. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, sales increased in North America and Europe, and revenue rose. Although there were headwinds, such as shipment suspensions of some products, ultrasound bronchoscopes and treatment tools used in EBUS-TBNA (endobronchial ultrasound-guided transbronchial needle aspiration) performed well and offset that impact.
entries.de507e2301166113: A field of endoscopes used in surgical procedures. Revenue declined in the fiscal year ended March 2026. Although the surgical endoscope system 'VISERA ELITEIII' performed well, sales declined in China, where competition intensified due to preferential policies for domestic products, and in Japan, where hospital budget constraints were severe.
